item.name: xbot_extensions.activity_invoice
item.item.desc: Digital Invoice Extension (MengBo) This instruction set implements interface-based invoicing by integrating a third-party platform.

item.name: xbot_extensions.activity_invoice.tax_invoice_auth_login.main
item.item.desc: Electronic Tax Bureau Login Log in to the Tax Bureau via the MengBo third-party platform. * @param app_id, App ID * @param secret, Secret key * @param tax_account, Tax bureau account * @param tax_password, Tax bureau password * @param nsrsbh, Taxpayer identification number * @param qr_code_type, QR code type * @param is_qr_code, Whether to use QR code login * @return invoice_instance, Invoice instance object

item.name: xbot_extensions.activity_invoice.tax_digital_invoicing.main
item.item.desc: Digital Invoice Issuance (Single-Line Summary) Automate invoice issuance on the MengBo third-party platform. * @param invoice_instance, Invoice instance object * @param kpxm, Goods name; must match the item information * @param ghfqylx, Buyer type: Enterprise / Government Institution / Individual * @param ghfmc, Buyer name * @param ghf_nsrsbh, Required when invoice type is VAT special invoice and buyer type is Enterprise * @param ghf_dz, Buyer address * @param ghf_dh, Buyer phone number * @param ghf_yh, Buyer bank name * @param ghf_zh, Buyer bank account number * @param sfzsgmfyhzh, Whether to print buyer bank account: Y/N, defaults to Y if left blank * @param sfzsxsfyhzh, Whether to print seller bank account: Y/N, defaults to Y if left blank * @param fpzl_dm, Invoice type: VAT Special Invoice / General Invoice * @param xsfzrr_bz, Seller legal representative flag: Y/N, defaults to N if left blank * @param gmfzrr_bz, Buyer legal representative flag: Y/N, defaults to N if left blank; Enterprise: N, Individual: Y * @param kphjje, Total invoice amount, 2 decimal places, in CNY (yuan) * @param xh, Line item sequence number; must be in ascending order for multiple detail lines * @param fphxz, Line type: Normal Item / Discount Line / Discounted Line * @param xmmc, Item name; must be prefixed with the commodity abbreviation in the format: *Abbreviation*Item Name. Discounts are only allowed on single-line items; the discount line must immediately follow the discounted line and share the same item name and commodity code. * @param xmdw, Unit of measure * @param xmsl, Item quantity, up to 8 decimal places * @param hsbz, Indicates whether the unit price and amount are tax-inclusive * @param spbm, Commodity code; pad with leading zeros if shorter than required length; for red-letter reversal of e-invoice list invoices, pass in the corresponding blue invoice line item data * @param yhzcbs, Preferential policy flag: Use / Do Not Use; defaults to Do Not Use * @param xmje, Item amount, 2 decimal places, in CNY (yuan), accurate to fen; equals unit price × quantity; whether tax-inclusive is determined by hsbz * @param xmdj, Unit price * @param sl, Tax rate, retain two significant decimal places; if 0, indicates tax-exempt (standard rates provided as decimals, e.g., 0.17); max 8 characters * @param se, Tax amount, 2 decimal places, in CNY (yuan), accurate to fen * @param ggxh, Specification and model * @param lslbs, Zero-rate tax type flag * @param bz, Remarks * @return invoiced_result, Invoicing result

item.name: xbot_extensions.activity_invoice.tax_invocie_order_query.main
item.item.desc: Invoice Information Query Query invoice information on the MengBo third-party platform. * @param invoice_instance, Invoice instance object * @param kplsh, Invoice serial number * @return invoice_detail, Invoice detail information

item.name: xbot_extensions.activity_invoice.tax_digital_invoicing_more.main
item.item.desc: Digital Invoice Issuance (Multi-Line Summary) Automate invoice issuance on the MengBo third-party platform. * @param invoice_instance, Invoice instance object * @param kpxm, Goods name; must match the item information * @param ghfqylx, Buyer type: Enterprise / Government Institution / Individual * @param ghfmc, Buyer name * @param ghf_nsrsbh, Required when invoice type is VAT special invoice and buyer type is Enterprise * @param ghf_dz, Buyer address * @param ghf_dh, Buyer phone number * @param ghf_yh, Buyer bank name * @param ghf_zh, Buyer bank account number * @param sfzsgmfyhzh, Whether to print buyer bank account: Y/N, defaults to Y if left blank * @param sfzsxsfyhzh, Whether to print seller bank account: Y/N, defaults to Y if left blank * @param fpzl_dm, Invoice type: VAT Special Invoice / General Invoice * @param xsfzrr_bz, Seller legal representative flag: Y/N, defaults to N if left blank * @param gmfzrr_bz, Buyer legal representative flag: Y/N, defaults to N if left blank; Enterprise: N, Individual: Y * @param kphjje, Total invoice amount, 2 decimal places, in CNY (yuan) * @param bz, Remarks * @param fpkjxx_xmxxs, Invoice line item detail list * @return invoiced_result, Invoicing result
